Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: one creative transparent character illustration for a school mascot gallery.
Reference image 1 supplies ONLY the recognizable design motifs: navy/indigo hair, blue eyes when visible, red angular bridge hair ornament, white/navy school costume with blue/red accents, wave-pattern cape, sneakers. The user explicitly asks to break repeated head angles, facial expressions and rigid reference-pose fidelity. You have creative freedom for pose, face angle, emotional expression, perspective, garment folds and visible costume pieces. Do NOT reuse the reference's front-facing, slightly tilted smiling face. Whole character including shoes and necessary small supporting furniture fits in frame with transparent padding. Transparent alpha background only: no wallpaper, typography, poster layout, decorative text, separate vignettes, shadows or extra people. Tasteful normal campus-life illustration.
Make a chibi version, big head and small compact body. TRUE 90-degree SIDE PROFILE facing right. Only ONE eye visible, the other fully hidden by profile anatomy; visible side nose and cheek contour. Head inclined DOWN about 20 degrees, quiet focused closed-mouth expression, brow softly concentrated. She sits on a simple small stool, knees bent and feet resting naturally, reading an open navy guidebook supported by both hands over her lap. Hair flows down her back, cape drapes with gravity; book is the focus. Absolutely no turning the face back towards the viewer or repeating a front-facing smile.

outputs.name: creative-back
outputs.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: corrected transparent full-body school mascot character illustration.
Input image 1 is an EDIT TARGET: its body anatomy is wrong and must be redrawn. Input image 2 is ONLY the identity and costume reference. Preserve the recognizably same navy long-haired, blue-eyed character, red angular bridge hair ornament and white bird ornaments, white/navy school uniform, blue/red details, wave-pattern cape and sneakers. Preserve these motifs, NOT the faulty limb placement.
Primary correction: redraw the ENTIRE BODY in a simple, anatomically coherent rear three-quarter STANDING pose. The shoulders, ribcage, waist, pelvis, thighs, knees, ankles and both feet ALL face the same direction, away from the viewer at a gentle angle. Clearly show the back of the uniform and back of the pleated skirt, never a front-facing pelvis under a back-facing chest. A single continuous natural spinal column and believable torso length. Two complete proportional legs emerge from the correct hip sockets; legs do not cross, knees bend only in their normal direction. Both sneaker soles are planted on the same invisible ground plane, feet comfortably apart, with weight mostly on one leg. No lifted foot, no running, no floating, no extreme S-curve or twisted waist.
Head and expression: turn her head gently over her right shoulder in a relaxed, curious surprised glance. A comfortable neck rotation, mostly side/profile face with only one eye dominant, raised brow and small softly open mouth. Make the neck connect naturally to the shoulders. Do not turn the pelvis to face the camera to show more face.
Arms and garments: right hand naturally carries a closed navy guidebook down beside the right hip, other arm relaxed. Shoulders and elbows anatomically plausible. Keep hair and cape softly draped so the body's side and rear skirt/pelvis orientation remain legible; do not hide broken anatomy in huge flying cloth. Natural fabric folds follow gravity and the same body orientation. Tasteful normal school-mascot framing.
Composition: polished anime illustration consistent with reference, complete head-to-shoes figure centered with ample transparent padding on every side. True transparent alpha background. No scene, floor, shadow, text, poster panels, extra people, extra limbs or watermark. Before final rendering, make the skeleton and rear view coherent from shoulders to planted feet.
